quack
Jul 2026 • Family
Came here to eat dinner after a long day in the ancient city. It was to say it out a bit contrasting. 

The service was great, even exceptional, but the food on the otherhand was contrasting. The appetizers were great, but the duck (main meal) was chewy and not too great. Honestly it is a risky business with duck as it is quite 50/50 with the quality. 

But other than the duck I was missing some other alternatives for appetizers. As I don’t usually eat pork or seafood finding a viable appetizer was quite impossible. Although I managed to get one without any pork so that was nicely done by the staff, again, great service.

I think this spot manages a 3.5/5 from me, not much to majorly improve as they’re already doing quite well, but still some small areas to reach the top of the charts.

Dear Axels,

Thank you so much for taking the time to share your thoughtful feedback with us.

We’re truly delighted to hear that our team made you feel well taken care of. Your kind words about our service mean a great deal to us, and we’ll be sure to pass your compliments on to the staff.

Your feedback has been shared with our kitchen team so we can review both the preparation and quality to ensure a better experience for future guests.

We also appreciate your comments regarding the appetizer selection. We understand that guests with dietary preferences such as avoiding pork and seafood would benefit from having more options. This is valuable feedback, and we’ll certainly take it into consideration as we continue to improve our menu.

Thank you again for recognizing both our strengths and the areas where we can do better. We truly appreciate your balanced review and hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back the next time you’re in Hội An. We would love the opportunity to provide you with an even better dining experience.
